faqData.q: What is your main area of expertise?
faqData.a: I am a Computer Engineering student focused on game development with Roblox Studio and Lua. I enjoy building game logic, designing game systems, and working with a team.

faqData.q: Are you available for research or freelance collaborations?
faqData.a: I am open to conversations about game development projects, game jams, and opportunities to keep learning and building with a team.

faqData.q: What is your typical tech stack for production?
faqData.a: My main game development tools are Roblox Studio and Lua. I also use Blender for 3D work and Cursor AI with MCP Server as part of my development workflow.

faqData.q: What projects have you worked on?
faqData.a: My projects include Bronopoly, a Roblox multiplayer economics game that reached the regional round of NSC 2026; HEAT THIEVES, made during a three-day GameJamX; and solo projects such as Anime Royale and Escape Lab.

faqData.q: How can we start a partnership or project?
faqData.a: Use the contact form above or email me at Wi.koo25561@gmail.com. I would be glad to hear about a game idea, collaboration, or learning opportunity.
